description: Source code for QuicChromiumPacketReader class handling UDP packet reading, including support for multiple packet reads on specific platforms, with detailed processing and error handling.

classes.name: QuicChromiumPacketReader
classes.description: Handles reading UDP packets, supports multiple packet reads on STARBOARD platform, processes packets, and manages read errors.

methods.name: StartReadingMultiplePackets
methods.description: Attempts to read multiple packets if supported; falls back if not.

methods.name: ProcessMultiplePacketReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of multiple packet read operation, handles errors, and notifies visitor.

methods.name: OnReadMultiplePacketComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of multiple packet read.

methods.name: StartReading
methods.description: Begins the reading process, using multiple packet read if supported, otherwise single read.

methods.name: ProcessReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a single read operation, handles errors, and notifies visitor.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a single read.
